steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page is where screen runs are recorded and reviewed. Let's load it to see what's new.
steps.point_out: The Desk page loads with a heading and several panels.

steps.title: View the latest screen run — it's a reused one
steps.narration: A reused run means the system recognized the same universe and screen state, so it didn't need to walk through the members again. This is a good outcome — it just says so honestly.
steps.point_out: The latest run shows 'reused screen-...' with the outcome text. Notice: no amber warning below it, and no counts line — the fix suppresses those misleading signals for reused runs.

steps.title: See the Screen Runs history table — it still shows every run
steps.narration: The history table keeps a full record of every screen run the system has performed. This append-only ledger is untouched by our fix.
steps.point_out: The table shows multiple rows, including at least one full walk (101 / 101) and the reused runs. Every record is preserved.

steps.title: Navigate to Structure from the ledger
steps.narration: The ledger panel offers a drill-in link to the Structure page, where support and resistance levels are visualized in detail.
steps.point_out: Clicking the Structure link takes you to the full levels view with zones and bars.

steps.title: Return to Desk via navigation
steps.narration: The top navigation makes it easy to jump between pages. Desk is now a first-class citizen in the app.
steps.point_out: Clicking the Desk link brings you back, and the page is still responsive and shows the same honest data.
